records.failureSummary:
Added/updated test/render.test.mjs with 5 AC-numbered tests for the renderTable skeleton, demonstrated fail-first, and ran the canonical suite green. Fail-first evidence: the exact AC assertions were bound to a deliberately incomplete stub (header row only - no separator, no data rows) in temporary files test/.tmp-red.test.mjs and test/.tmp-red-stub.mjs; node --test test/.tmp-red.test.mjs exited 1 with all 4 tests failing: [AC-01] line count 1 !== 4; [AC-02] actual | A | B | vs expected | A | B |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |
| 3 | 4 |; [AC-03] TypeError Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace') because line index 1 is undefined; [AC-04] line count 1 !== 2. Both temp files were then deleted (test dir now contains only parse.test.mjs and render.test.mjs) and no product code was modified; git status shows only the pre-existing task-2 change to src/render.mjs and the new untracked test/render.test.mjs. Final canonical run via npm run test (script is node --test) reports tests 6, pass 6, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, including the pre-existing parse test, so src/parse.mjs behavior is unchanged. Coverage: AC-01 output line count equals 2 + table.rows.length with order header row, separator row, then data rows in rows order; AC-02 single 
 join with no trailing newline and no blank line; AC-03 separator column count equals table.headers.length and every cell is ---; AC-04 rows: [] yields exactly two lines (header + separator) joined by 
; AC-05 assertions stay on the baseline separator and do not depend on options.align variants (out of scope for this slice). Note: the literal command pnpm test cannot run in this sandbox (sh: 1: pnpm: not found, exit 127); the equivalent package.json test script (node --test) was executed and passes.
